build.description: The driver opens the builder execution stage for the current build round before it waits for the builder return.
build.charter: Builder seat: implement the accepted plan within the declared scope and return the structured build evidence.

check.description: The driver opens the plan-check stage for the current round before checking the planner's returned plan.
check.charter: Planner seat: provide a bounded plan whose files, tests, and acceptance evidence can be checked.

commit.description: The driver opens the commit stage when it is ready to create the task commit from the accepted tree.

converge.description: The driver records convergence after the terminal suite, publication, and residual decisions have been handled.

directed.description: The directed execution shape opens its brief-led round before the declared reviewed stages continue.

document.description: The driver opens the documentation stage to record the accepted task decision and its durable evidence.

done.description: The envelope path records done after the structured envelope has passed the envelope acceptance checks.

envelope-accept.description: The envelope path opens its acceptance stage to validate the returned structured envelope before settling it.

escalate.description: The driver records the terminal escalation stage for the point where the run stopped, just before it parks the lane for a human.

gate.description: The driver opens the acceptance-gate stage for the built tree and records the gate result before deciding what follows.

gate-baseline.description: The driver runs the acceptance gate against the baseline tree before accepting work from a reviewed plan.

gate-proof.description: The driver records a gate-proof stage while measuring whether the acceptance gate distinguishes the built tree from the pristine tree.

gate-repair.description: The driver records a gate-repair stage when gate custody assigns the bounded repair of a diagnosed gate defect.

gate-reverify.description: The driver labels the re-verification proof after a repaired gate is accepted for another pristine-tree measurement.

lane.description: The driver opens the validation-lane stage to run the declared lane against the built checkout.

plan.description: The reviewed execution path opens the plan stage before assigning the planner the task brief and scope.
plan.charter: Planner seat: translate the brief into a bounded implementation plan with files, tests, and acceptance evidence.

publish.description: The driver opens the publication stage when the accepted commit is eligible for the configured publication path.

rebase.description: The driver opens the rebase stage to reconcile an accepted commit with the configured publication base.

repair.description: The bounded-repair shape opens its triage stage before assigning the inherited failure and scope to the builder.
repair.charter: Planner seat: scout the inherited failure and write the smallest bounded repair note for the builder.

review.description: The driver opens the reviewer stage for the current round and records the review return before acceptance.
review.charter: Reviewer seat: inspect the returned tree against the brief and report structured findings with evidence.

review_only.description: The read-only review shape opens its review-only envelope round before its reviewer returns structured findings.
review_only.charter: Reviewer seat: review the supplied base and head without changing the checkout and return the complete report.

scope-gate.description: The driver opens the scope gate to compare changed files with the declared scope before accepting the stage result.

scout.description: The scout envelope shape opens its read-only reconnaissance round before collecting findings for acceptance.
scout.charter: Planner seat: read the brief and checkout, record evidence-backed recon findings, and change nothing.

suite.description: The driver opens the suite stage to run the configured warm validation suite after the accepted tree is assembled.

verify_only.description: The read-only verification shape opens its verification envelope round before its reviewer returns the complete matrix.
verify_only.charter: Reviewer seat: verify the declared targets without changing the checkout and return measured results and assumptions.
